label: Water
description: Waterscapes as hero subjects — the water explaining the landform it made.

items.name: plunge-falls
items.text: a single plunge waterfall dropping unbroken into the mist-filled amphitheater it carved for itself, spray climbing back up the walls, everything within reach glossed in moss

items.name: tiered-cascades
items.text: travertine terraces stepping down in milky turquoise pools, every rim built a little higher by the lime the water itself lays down

items.name: glacial-lake
items.text: a wind-still glacial lake doubling the peaks in perfect symmetry, suspended rock flour tinting the water milk-turquoise

items.name: river-bend
items.text: a river meander swinging through a shadowed gorge, bright gravel banked on the inside of the bend, the outside cut into a dark undercut wall

items.name: wild-coast
items.text: storm surf detonating against black basalt sea stacks, spray thrown mast-high and stripped sideways off the crests by the gale

items.name: turquoise-cove
items.text: a sheltered cove of turquoise water over pale carbonate sand, ringed by white limestone cliffs, the seabed readable five meters down

items.name: braided-river
items.text: a glacial outwash river weaving silver channels across grey gravel, splitting and rejoining around bars the last flood built

items.name: hot-spring-terrace
items.text: steaming hot-spring terraces banded orange, rust and white by thermophile microbial mats, each color ring marking a different water temperature

items.name: tidal-flats
items.text: rippled tidal flats at low water holding the sky's colors in a skin of sheet water, drainage channels branching seaward like bare winter trees

items.name: bioluminescent-shore
items.text: waves breaking in electric blue bioluminescence along a dark shore, the dinoflagellate bloom flaring wherever the water is disturbed, wet sand glowing at every footprint

items.name: mangrove-maze
items.text: a mangrove channel maze threading glassy brackish water, each tree stilted on arched prop roots above its own reflection, fiddler crab burrows dimpling the exposed mud

items.name: spring-pool
items.text: a gin-clear artesian spring pool over white sand, the upwelling boil keeping loose grains dancing, light caustics wandering the bottom

items.name: tide-pool-microcosm
items.text: a rocky tide pool at low water, jade anemones open below a mirror surface that doubles the cliffs

items.name: wave-barrel
items.text: inside a breaking barrel wave, the falling lip drawn into a curtain of green glass around the hollow

items.name: frozen-falls
items.text: a waterfall locked mid-plunge into blue-white ice pillars, meltwater still threading behind the deep-winter curtain

items.name: estuary-flats
items.text: a tidal estuary at low water, channels braiding through mud flats, wading birds spread out and the sea a long way off
items.text_short: tidal estuary braiding through mud flats

items.name: seaweed-shore
items.text: a shore heaped with seaweed at the tide line, bladderwrack popping underfoot and kelp stipes tangled among the stones
items.text_short: shore heaped with seaweed at the tide line

items.name: rice-paddy
items.text: a flooded rice paddy mirroring the sky between narrow bunds, seedlings set in ranks and a farmer working the line
items.text_short: flooded rice paddy mirroring the sky
